items.note: The component shipped in 0.8.0 as ds-auth-shell and is renamed to ds-auth-layout. "Shell" is not this library's word for a layout: the app-level one was renamed ds-app-shell -> ds-app-layout in 0.7.0, and calling the auth counterpart a shell put the split vocabulary back. ACTION, mechanical and complete: rename the element <ds-auth-shell> to <ds-auth-layout>, the imported class AuthShellComponent to AuthLayoutComponent, and any of the six tokens you override from --ds-auth-shell-* to --ds-auth-layout-* (min-height, card-max-width, gap, bg-color, mark-bg-color, mark-label-color). Behaviour, inputs and slots are unchanged - [dsAuthSupport], [dsBrandName], brand, logoLetter, tagline, cardElevation and cardPadding all keep their names.
